guarantees: Edge receipt ok=true plus nonempty notification_id; no contradictory error.
Requested push requires a positive integer push_sent and push_failed=0.
Requested email requires an available recipient/provider and a nonempty Resend id.
A single 10000ms deadline includes transports, JSON bodies and auth lookup.
Fetches receive a shared AbortSignal; every awaited continuation checks expiration before any follow-up.
Errors omit provider payloads, credentials and recipient data; no automatic retry.
limitations: External providers and auth are inert doubles in this suite; no real notification sent.
A provider receipt proves acceptance, not reading by a recipient.
The Supabase admin auth lookup has no AbortSignal in its current API; its late result cannot start an email.
Expiration does not prove that a remote effect did not occur.
